pages.text: EACH goes through an array or a hash.$(br2)A name for the loop variable and a LABEL with the array or hash follow. For an array, the loop variable gets each element in order. For a hash, it gets each key in alphabetical order.
The loop works on a copy, so changing the list inside the loop doesn't change the loop. You can't change the loop variable yourself.
Craft a structural base and a cobblestone block, or turn a FOR block into an EACH block.
$(1)EACH key h$(br)BEGIN$(br)  ASSIGN keys keys ⊕ key ⊕ "=" ⊕ h[key] ⊕ " " ;$(br)END EACH$()
